The funding is intended to support network expansion, technology upgrades and operational scaling. Funding Details and Allocation The round comprises $6 million in equity and $2 million in venture debt. Existing investors Shastra VC, Antler India and Gemba Capital participated alongside lead investor Prime Venture Partners. The capital will be used to add new dark stores, onboard additional brands and enhance the platform’s technology stack.
